mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, parent_comment_id, content, writer_id, writer_name, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_common_comment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT comment_id, tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, parent_comment_id, content, writer_id, writer_name, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_common_comment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO tb_common_comment ( tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, parent_comment_id, content, writer_id, writer_name, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{parentCommentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{content}, #{writerId}, #{writerName}, #{deletedYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING comment_id
